shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md 2>/dev/null || true
sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml 2>/dev/null || true
rg --files | rg '(registry|chatOrchestrator).*test|package.json"'$|AGENTS.md$|spec-links'"' | head -80"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,220p' AGENTS.md
find specs -maxdepth 3 -type f -name '*.md' -print 2>/dev/null | sort
git status --short --branch
sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts
sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts
cat package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' src/shared/logger.ts
rg -n \"ToolRegistry|tool_calls|toolUse|tool_result|toolResult|stopReason.*tool\" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/types/ai.ts src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts | head -160
sed -n '1,180p' src/types/ai.ts
rg -n \"specs/.+#|validated by\" src/**/*.test.ts | head -30
sed -n '1,140p' specs/hal-engine-tool-responses/spec.md"
